skill.name: ecommerce-live-sales-script
skill.description: 当用户准备直播带货，需要整场流程、商品讲解、互动问答和转场话术时使用。根据排品清单、真实商品资料与已确认活动规则，输出可照读的话术和时间表。已有资料可直接写；抖音、小红书商品详情可按需补充。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Draft timed livestream sales scripts with product demonstrations, audience Q&A, and transitions based on confirmed facts.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown formatting, product identifiers, or Chinese prose. The optional lookup workflow does request execution of an unpinned package, which is documented to read and persist a service credential. Shell templates lack input-handling safeguards, and metered lookups lack a clear approval step.

remediation.issue: Product URLs and IDs are shown as shell substitutions.
remediation.suggestion: Pass validated product inputs as separate arguments without a shell, or use an approved product lookup tool with structured inputs.

remediation.issue: Authentication and lookup commands run a mutable npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before running the CLI. Pin a reviewed package version, verify its integrity, and remove automatic acceptance of package installation.

remediation.issue: The CLI reads a service key and can persist it in a local JSON file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a scoped service key and a managed secret store where available. Document how users revoke credentials and remove stored copies.

remediation.issue: Metered requests and retries have no explicit charge approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose possible credit use before lookup. Ask for approval before a retry that could consume credits again.

content.value_statement: Livestream hosts need to fit accurate product explanations, offers, and audience questions into a fixed schedule. This skill drafts a timed script from your product lineup and confirmed promotion details.
actual_capabilities: Build a continuous schedule for the requested duration, with openings, product segments, audience interaction, and a closing.
Draft a full show or a single product segment using the supplied specifications and confirmed offers.
Write demonstration suggestions, buyer questions and answers, and transitions between products.
Separate host copy from fact sources, assumptions, and items the merchant needs to verify.
Optionally request Douyin or Xiaohongshu product details through a configured SocialDataX CLI or MCP connection.
limitations: Produces text drafts only. It does not broadcast, send messages, change prices or stock, or create images, audio, or video.
Online lookup covers only Douyin and Xiaohongshu through SocialDataX. It requires authenticated access and may consume service credits.
A product page price does not confirm a live offer. Provide confirmed prices, stock, deadlines, and delivery terms separately.
Without enough product facts, the skill can outline the show but cannot write specific claims. It does not guarantee compliance or sales.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Demonstration
use_cases.description: Turn verified product features and common buyer questions into a script for one segment.

use_cases.title: Plan a Timed Product Lineup
use_cases.description: Assign each item a time slot and add opening lines, transitions, audience questions, and a closing.

use_cases.title: Review Promotion Claims
use_cases.description: Check draft offers against approved terms and separate unsupported claims from lines the host can read.

prompt_templates.title: Draft One Product Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a two-minute segment for [product] using [verified facts]. Include a demonstration suggestion, one buyer question, and a purchase invitation.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have confirmed facts for one item.

prompt_templates.title: Schedule a Full Show
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a [duration] livestream in this order: [products]. Use [product notes] and give each segment a start time, end time, and transition.
prompt_templates.scenario: You have a lineup and a fixed show length.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Promotion Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Write host lines and audience answers using [product facts] and [approved offers]. Keep eligibility with each offer and list missing details separately.
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to explain offers without overstating them.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Multi-Product Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [draft script] against [product facts] and [promotion rules]. Check that time slots cover [duration] without overlap. Rewrite unsupported claims and list what needs verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: You are checking the script before rehearsal.

output_examples.input: Draft a short segment for a 500 mL bottle with a screw cap. No price or stock details are confirmed.
output: Host: This bottle holds 500 mL and closes with a screw cap. I will show you how the cap fits.
Audience question: Is it dishwasher safe? Host: I do not have confirmed care instructions, so I will leave that open.
Merchant to verify before the show: care instructions, live price, and stock.

output_examples.input: Plan a 10-minute livestream for a folding stand and a cable pouch. No promotion is confirmed.
output: 00:00 to 01:00: Open the show and introduce both products.
01:00 to 04:00: Show how the stand folds and opens.
04:00 to 07:00: Introduce the cable pouch and demonstrate how cables fit inside.
07:00 to 09:00: Answer viewer questions using confirmed product details.
09:00 to 10:00: Recap both products and close without an offer or a countdown.

best_practices: Provide product facts, their sources, the show duration, and any required product order.
Give the confirmed live price, promotion dates, eligibility, and stock limits for each item.
Rehearse the timing and keep verification notes separate from the host script.
anti_patterns: Treating the product page price as an approved livestream offer.
Adding stock claims, countdowns, test results, or testimonials without evidence.
Including API keys in chat, scripts, or product notes.

faq.question: Do I need an API key to draft a script?
faq.answer: No. Drafting from supplied product facts does not require a key. Optional online lookups require an authenticated SocialDataX connection or CLI.

faq.question: Which product links or IDs can the skill look up?
faq.answer: It supports Douyin product links or IDs and Xiaohongshu product links or SKU IDs. For other platforms, provide the product details directly.

faq.question: Can I request only one product segment?
faq.answer: Yes. Request one segment and provide its product facts and desired length. A full schedule is optional.

faq.question: What happens if I do not specify a duration?
faq.answer: The skill can draft a 30-minute show for one host and mark that duration as an assumption.

faq.question: How does the skill handle missing offer details?
faq.answer: It leaves unconfirmed details out of the spoken script and can list them separately for the merchant to verify.

faq.question: Will the skill start or manage my livestream?
faq.answer: No. It drafts text and can look up product details. It does not start a broadcast, post messages, or change product listings.
